name: manage_avatar
description: Read live AI-avatar capabilities, official avatars, saved avatars, and provider-neutral voice choices; create, revise, import, inspect, or delete an avatar; and inspect or edit avatar-video batches and attempts. Load the digital-human Skill before use. Resolve only the fields needed by the user's current intent; this is not a fixed wizard. Avatar selection is always preview-mandatory. Never ask with text-only saved-versus-official options. Read saved identities and the official catalog, then use the Widget Forms Skill's visual-choice surface for the current host. In embedded ChatCut, write each concrete ready identity only as <visual-option avatar-id="identityId"/>; the host prefers its live preview video and falls back to its preview image. In Codex, never emit raw ChatCut tags: use identityId as id, name as label, previewVideoUrl as previewVideo, and previewImageUrl as preview so it remains the poster and fallback. Official catalog results include curated tags for factual filtering and a description explaining suitable use cases. Use both to recommend among returned avatars, and never infer missing identity attributes from appearance. When the user specifies gender, age, ethnicity, or a search intent, pass the corresponding catalog filters so the backend filters the complete database-backed catalog before pagination. Keep the same filters when using a returned continuation token. For an official avatar with a returned defaultVoiceRef, first ask whether to use its official built-in voice or choose another voice, then stop and wait. If accepted, use that defaultVoiceRef. For a saved custom avatar with a returned defaultVoiceRef, use it automatically unless the user explicitly asks to change voices; do not ask them to confirm the saved default again. Call action="voices" only after the official-avatar user chooses another voice, when the custom-avatar user asks to change voices, or when no defaultVoiceRef exists. When an exact non-default voice must be selected, audition is mandatory: never ask with text-only voice-name pills. For action="voices", recommend only entries with a non-empty previewUrl through the Widget Forms Skill's playable voice-choice surface and always append a localized clone_voice action. In embedded ChatCut this is one <form-visual id="voiceRef" media-kind="audio"> with playable <visual-option/> cards and a final <visual-option value="clone_voice" name="Clone Voice"/> card; in published plugins never emit raw ChatCut tags and map voiceRef to the host option id and previewUrl to its audio URL. Photo-avatar creation requires an imported project JPEG/PNG plus explicit likeness consent. Never pass an external source URL. Delete only after explicit confirmation. Voice results expose opaque voiceRef values. Do not request, infer, or reveal the underlying provider, model, engine, or provider-specific identifiers.

age.description: For catalog: filter by the curated age bucket.

batchId.description: Required for get-batch, regenerate-segment, remove-segment, and reorder-segments. Accepts a unique id prefix.

confirmedConsent.description: Required and true when create/create-revision uses a real-person image. The user explicitly confirmed ownership or permission.

confirmedDelete.description: Required and true for delete after the user explicitly confirmed permanent deletion.

ethnicity.description: For catalog: filter by curated ethnicity metadata.

gender.description: For catalog: filter by curated gender metadata.

identityId.description: Required for get, import, create-revision, and delete. Accepts a unique id prefix.

limit.description: Catalog page size or total playable voice result limit, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 5. Use exactly 5 when recommending avatars or voices; request more only when the user explicitly asks to browse more.

name.description: Required for create; optional when importing an official avatar.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

prompt.description: Synthetic-avatar description for prompt creation or revision.

query.description: For catalog: search the database-backed name, description, provider look ID, and tags.

refresh.description: For get: refresh non-terminal identity revisions first.

segmentId.description: Required for regenerate-segment and remove-segment. Accepts a unique id prefix.

segmentIds.description: For reorder-segments, every active segment exactly once in the intended order.

sourceAssetId.description: Imported ChatCut JPEG/PNG asset for photo create/create-revision. A video must be converted to a representative still first.

speech.description: Optional replacement speech source object for regenerate-segment. Pass an object, never a quoted or JSON-stringified value.

voiceRef.description: Opaque ChatCut voice reference returned by manage_avatar action=voices.

taskId.description: Required for get-task, accept-task, and retry-task. Accepts a unique id prefix.

text.description: Optional replacement text for regenerate-segment when keeping the existing voice.

token.description: Opaque continuation token for catalog or voices.

voiceRef.description: Required for set-default-voice: opaque voiceRef (from action=voices) to save as the avatar's default voice for future generations.
